name: ccz_management_area
citation: International Seabed Authority (2023). The geographical limits of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone management area, exploration areas, reserved areas and areas of particular environmental interest (APEIs) — ISBA/17/LTC/7, ISBA/18/C/22, ISBA/26/C/58, ISBA/26/C/43. Digitised and redistributed by Marine Regions (Flanders Marine Institute) as MRGID 64222, gazetteer entry last edited 2023-03-13, retrieved 2026-08-25 via the geo.vliz.be WFS. Ledger row: src_ccz_boundary_marineregions in data/sources/source_queue.yaml.
$comment: CONTRACT 2 — Study-area / AOI geometry. GeoJSON (RFC 7946): coordinates are [longitude, latitude] in WGS84 / CRS84 by definition, so no 'crs' member is included. THE AOI IS THE REGION THIS PROJECT IS ABOUT, NOT THE REGION THE MODEL MAY PREDICT OVER (G.2, Karl's decision 2026-08-25, option (b)). The two were tangled and are now separate: this polygon is externally defined, never moves as the corpus grows, and is THE DENOMINATOR for coverage — 'x% of the CCZ has variogram support' means nothing if the CCZ moves. WHERE THE MODEL MAY EMIT VALUES is a different question, already answered elsewhere and NOT by this file: PredictionGrid.from_stack() inherits the feature stack's extent and manifest.prediction_grid records it per run. NOTHING FILTERS OR CLIPS ON THIS POLYGON TODAY (verified G.2-PRE: FileTerrainSource.load() accepts a StudyArea and never references it) — its consumers are the coverage block, the contract_versions hash, and the corpus manifest's descriptive containment count. GEOMETRY PROVENANCE: the coordinates are VERBATIM from the raw Marine Regions WFS response preserved at data/aoi/sources/ccz_management_area_mrgid64222.geojson (sha256 98aa2a83ad5fe071...); ONLY the properties were rewritten, because Contract 2 requires area_id/name and the download carries {'dummy': 0, 'mrgid': 64222}. tests/test_study_area_aoi.py asserts the two geometries are equal, so the edit cannot drift. THE TWO-PART MULTIPOLYGON IS THE PUBLISHER'S AND IS KEPT (G.2 decision): part 0 is a 1.41 km2 triangle that TOUCHES the main polygon at exactly one point — its own ring-closure vertex (-159.08957834, 7.79794191) — i.e. a digitisation spur at the seam, not an island. Kept rather than dropped so the geometry still verifies against the source; recorded here so no library resolves it by accident. Its area is 0.0000123% of the total and changes no coverage figure at any precision this project quotes.

properties.name: Clarion-Clipperton Zone management area (MRGID 64222)
properties.authority_note: A REDISTRIBUTION, not the primary record. ISA's own Esri shapefiles at isa.org.jm/exploration-contracts/maps/ are primary; this polygon is Marine Regions' digitisation of the ISBA-document limits. The gazetteer status is 'Proposed standard', last edited 2023-03-13, and the documents it cites run to ISBA/26/C/58 — if ISA has revised the limits since, this polygon would not reflect it.
properties.self_description_note: The source file vouches for NOTHING: its properties are {'dummy': 0, 'mrgid': 64222} — no name, no citation, no date, no licence. Every piece of provenance therefore lives in this declaration and the ledger row, with nothing embedded to cross-check against. Contrast GEBCO, whose own documentation supplied its DERIVED evidence.
